Product Features

  • Space-saving floating design: The stable wall mounting leaves room on the floor for easy cleaning by the robot sweeper and creates a minimalist-modern style, ideal for small families!
  • Intelligent APP Control of LED Light Strips: Customize thousands of colors as you like with your mobile phone! Switch to deep blue light to create a cinematic atmosphere while watching a movie, and switch to warm gold to create a cozy focal point at a party and effortlessly control the mood in the living room.
  • High Gloss Surface + Blue Acrylic Lines: The bright white glossy panel with blue acrylic frame is not only a practical TV cabinet, but also a fashionable work of art that visitors will fall in love with at first sight. (The highlight position is limited to the housing surface)
  • Cushioned Fold-Down Door Design (3-Door Configuration): It opens quietly and slowly with light touch; the translucent acrylic sheet in the middle diffuses the LED light evenly; Opening it in the evening acts like a gentle filter and gives it a high-quality feel.
  • 5 scientifically divided storage areas: Game consoles, set-top boxes and remote controls all find their right place and tangled cables are hidden away, making your living room look clutterier and tidier.
  • High-density chipboard material (load capacity 45kg): It provides a stable grip for a 75-inch TV and audio equipment, and is rock solid when setting up decorations, so you have a safe "air stand".
  • User-friendly angle for removing objects: The opening angle of the downward folding door has been carefully designed. You don't have to bend down to take items from the middle level. The soft acrylic light is not dazzling, making it easier to take snacks while watching TV series.
  • Versatile living style: A magical tool for visually expanding small apartments, an exquisite finishing touch for large apartments, perfect for various decoration styles such as modern, Nordic and minimalist.
  • USB Powered – Comes with a 5V 2A USB cable (USB plug not included) that can be connected to your TV, computer, power bank, etc. Safe and easy to use indoors

Descriptions

Description

This wall-mounted TV cabinet features a space-saving floating design with a sturdy wall bracket, which keeps the floor clear and easy to clean. It fits many styles and is an ideal choice for both large and small apartments. It is made of high-density chipboard and can support 45kg to support appliances and decorations stably. The bright white high-gloss finish of the case (high-gloss only on the surface of the case) is combined with blue acrylic lines, which is both practical and artistic. The three cushioned folding doors open with a light tap and lower silently. Through the translucent acrylic plate in the middle, the app-controlled LED light strip can evenly diffuse the light and adjust thousands of colors to create a varied atmosphere. The 5 scientific divisions inside make it possible to put objects in their proper place. The lower hinged door provides a convenient angle for removing items, so you don't have to bend over. The soft light does not dazzle and helps you to say goodbye to the clutter in the living room and to harmonize order and mood without any problems.
